import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import lax

# Example 1: JVP symmetry test
try:
    x = jnp.linspace(0.1, 8.9, 100, dtype=jnp.float32)
    g = jnp.full_like(x, 1.3)
    
    # Compute JVP at +x
    jvp_pos = jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (x,), (g,))[1]
    
    # Compute JVP at -x
    jvp_neg = jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (-x,), (g,))[1]
    
    # Record both JVP values and their equality
    probe("x = jnp.linspace(0.1, 8.9, 100, dtype=jnp.float32); g = jnp.full_like(x, 1.3); jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (x,), (g,)) - jvp_pos", jvp_pos)
    probe("x = jnp.linspace(0.1, 8.9, 100, dtype=jnp.float32); g = jnp.full_like(x, 1.3); jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (x,), (g,)) - jvp_neg", jvp_neg)
    probe("x = jnp.linspace(0.1, 8.9, 100, dtype=jnp.float32); g = jnp.full_like(x, 1.3); jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (x,), (g,)) - arrays_equal", jnp.allclose(jvp_pos, jvp_neg, rtol=0, atol=0))
    
except Exception as e:
    probe("x = jnp.linspace(0.1, 8.9, 100, dtype=jnp.float32); g = jnp.full_like(x, 1.3); jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (x,), (g,))", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))

# Example 2: Gradient symmetry test
try:
    x = jnp.linspace(0.1, 8.9, 100, dtype=jnp.float32)
    
    grad_fn = jax.vmap(jax.grad(lambda z: jnp.float32(1.3) * lax.tanh(z)))
    
    grad_pos = grad_fn(x)
    grad_neg = grad_fn(-x)
    
    # Record both gradient values and their equality
    probe("grad_fn = jax.vmap(jax.grad(lambda z: jnp.float32(1.3) * lax.tanh(z))); grad_fn(x) vs grad_fn(-x) - grad_pos", grad_pos)
    probe("grad_fn = jax.vmap(jax.grad(lambda z: jnp.float32(1.3) * lax.tanh(z))); grad_fn(x) vs grad_fn(-x) - grad_neg", grad_neg)
    probe("grad_fn = jax.vmap(jax.grad(lambda z: jnp.float32(1.3) * lax.tanh(z))); grad_fn(x) vs grad_fn(-x) - arrays_equal", jnp.allclose(grad_pos, grad_neg, rtol=0, atol=0))
    
except Exception as e:
    probe("grad_fn = jax.vmap(jax.grad(lambda z: jnp.float32(1.3) * lax.tanh(z))); grad_fn(x) vs grad_fn(-x)", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))
